description: This file contains a jQuery plugin for rotating images, including functions for applying rotation effects, handling different browser implementations, and managing rotation animations.

classes.name: Wilq32.PhotoEffect
classes.description: A class managing the image rotation effect, including setup, animation, and browser-specific handling.

methods.name: _setupParameters
methods.description: Initializes rotation parameters such as angle, duration, easing, and center point.

methods.name: _defaultEasing
methods.description: Default easing function for rotation animation.

methods.name: _handleRotation
methods.description: Handles the rotation process, including setup and animation start.

methods.name: _BindEvents
methods.description: Binds or unbinds event handlers for rotation controls.

methods.name: _Loader
methods.description: Loads the image and prepares the canvas or VML for rotation, depending on browser support.

methods.name: _animate
methods.description: Performs the animation step, updating rotation based on easing.

methods.name: _rotate
methods.description: Applies the rotation transformation to the image or canvas.
